title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f69r outer and radial texts form one wind account or independent registers
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. The admitted f69r diagram has a twelve-part colored wind skeleton, sixteen outer text items and twenty-two radial items. GDT1067 proves that its existing geometry admits paired source and destination orientations; GDT1068 finds no unchanged complete f67r2 title in either f69r text register. A complete reading could nevertheless let the outer ring state conditions or divisions and the radial register identify winds under those conditions, or could treat both registers as separate catalogues around a shared illustration. This is a relation hypothesis, not a way to select compass orientation or a wind name. Freeze all sixteen outer and twenty-two radial items and their owner boundaries. An independently visible or sourced mapping between particular outer and radial items is a prerequisite for a fixed test; angle proximity and shared short groups do not supply it. Primaries: experiments/yolo/gdt1067_f69r_wind_polarity_identifiability/REPORT.md; experiments/yolo/gdt1068_f67r2_f69r_whole_title_overlap/REPORT.md.

design.mechanism: The two text registers express a dependent condition-to-wind or division-to-wind relation in a complete diagram account.
design.unit: All sixteen complete f69r outer items and all twenty-two complete radial items, with the twelve colored visual units, in each alternate transcription of the same manuscript.
design.contrast: One dependent two-register account versus two independent lists or a decorative textual ring; source-bearing and destination-bearing remain unresolved subrivals of the dependent account.
design.prediction: A dependent account must supply a single consistent item-owner relation and written relation type that covers every claimed pair and explains unpaired items; the independent-list account predicts no such cross-register references. Any full interpretation must preserve all 38 text items and may not choose a rotation or polarity from the existing symmetric color fit. Without independent ownership, the models remain observationally equivalent and no lexical selection is licensed.
design.prior_blockers: GDT1067's 180-degree polarity symmetry; GDT1068's zero whole-title matches; neither radial nor outer texts have independent one-to-one wind owners.
design.scope: Exploratory whole-diagram proposal on already admitted f69r; no orientation, name assignment, reserve access or scored relation packet.
